quiz.q: What did Kraków City Hall propose for the Clean Transport Zone (SCT) this week?
options: Extending it to the whole of Małopolska
Shrinking it from about 196 km² to about 1 km² around the centre
Scrapping it entirely from January
Doubling the entry fee for older cars
quiz.explain: The draft resolution would cut the SCT from roughly 196 km² to about 0.99 km²; public consultation runs 27 Nov–18 Dec.

quiz.q: What was the outcome of the constructive no-confidence vote against Donald Tusk's government in the Sejm?
options: It passed and a new PM was named
It was withdrawn before the vote
It was rejected
It was postponed to December
quiz.explain: The Sejm rejected the motion filed by Mateusz Morawiecki's Rozwój Plus club, so Tusk's government stays in office.

quiz.q: How long was Nikhil Gupta sentenced to in the Pannun murder-for-hire case?
options: 5 years
235 months (about 19.5 years)
Life imprisonment
Time served
quiz.explain: Judge Victor Marrero in Manhattan sentenced Gupta to 235 months; India has not commented.

lessonQuiz.q: What makes Poland a unitary state even though its voivodeships have elected assemblies?
options: Voivodeships have no budgets
Their powers come from ordinary national law, which parliament can change
The President appoints every councillor
Poland has no local elections
lessonQuiz.explain: In a unitary state sovereignty stays with the centre; regional powers are granted by statute rather than guaranteed as in a federation.

lessonQuiz.q: Which is true of an FDA guidance document?
options: It binds companies like a statute
It must pass Congress
It states the FDA's current thinking but is not legally binding
It can only be issued by the President
lessonQuiz.explain: Guidance binds neither companies nor the agency, but companies usually follow it because the FDA decides on approvals.

lessonQuiz.q: Under the Youngstown test, when is a president's executive order on the weakest footing?
options: When Congress has expressly authorised it
When Congress has said nothing
When it contradicts the expressed or implied will of Congress
When it is published in the Federal Register
lessonQuiz.explain: Justice Jackson's third zone: acting against Congress, the president can rely only on his own constitutional powers.
